page.title: About Loom woven placemat, set of 2

product.name: Loom woven placemat, set of 2
product.description: It rested two nights at the loom room, then went into a cotton sack, batch wool tray seventy seven.

blocks.text: The weaver held it a cool evening so the weave stays flat, batch iron bin thirty three.
A cotton sack from the cutting table suits a two-person table, batch birch hook forty six.
Wet linen shows up in this run, and shake crumbs off and wipe the mats with a damp cloth, batch amber nook fifty nine.
Tuesday at the loom room was for a cold rinse, and the slip reads river pail twenty.

presentation.review_line: Read the lines, then pay if they still fit.

trick.evidence_text: Brass hook is four dollars and fifty three cents if the filled action is the one you press.
trick.instruction: Use the quiet control in the panel so Brass hook stays off this order.
